items.title: [2026-07-08] Hire local, free — post a job, candidates reach you direct (Image Prompt)
items.content:
Editorial local-hiring marketplace promo poster, vertical 4:5, QckServe brand.

SCENE: a bright small Indian business in the morning — a shop or small office where a friendly owner greets a new hire directly, no consultant or agent in frame; warm, everyday, real.
SUBJECT: the owner-to-candidate handshake as the emotional focus — confident, welcoming, human; the moment a local job is filled directly.
PHONE-UI MOCKUP: a floating smartphone shows the QckServe app job-post screen — a role card with title, pay, location, an 'Apply / Call owner' button, and a bold '₹0 to post' badge.
COLOUR SYSTEM: flat colour blocking, NO gradients — deep charcoal #1A1A1A base, primary orange #ef6723, accent #FF6B00, off-white #FCF9F8 for cards; one accent used sparingly.
LIGHTING: soft clean morning daylight, gentle shadows, crisp and optimistic.
TYPE HIERARCHY: one oversized condensed headline 'POST A JOB. HIRE DIRECT.', an italic-serif kicker 'hire local, no middleman', small 'qckserve.in' wordmark bottom-left.
EYE FLOW: bold statement headline → giant ₹0 → handshake → phone UI → wordmark.
CAMERA: 35mm, eye-level, shallow depth of field, editorial magazine framing.
PERFORMANCE LAYER: high thumb-stopping contrast, mobile-first legibility, one memorable device (the giant ₹0 posting fee).
Reserve the TOP-LEFT logo zone empty (~140px square) — logo placed manually.
